title: Partial Rate of Change in the Ideal Gas Law
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For an ideal gas P = n R T / V, find dP/dT at V = 10 L assuming n R = 8.314 J/K.

steps.title: Differentiate P with Respect to T at Constant V
steps.mathExpression: \frac{\partial P}{\partial T} = \frac{\partial}{\partial T} \left( \frac{n R T}{V} \right) = \frac{n R}{V}
steps.explanation: Treat volume V and gas constant nR as constants.
